name: plnty
description: Make and edit pictures and video with Plnty's tools, from the chat.

interface.longDescription: Make and change pictures and video with Plnty's creative tools, from the conversation. Attach a photo or pick one from your Plnty library, then ask for an edit, a set of variations, a cut-out, an upscale or a clip: the result lands in your library and shows right here. Before a creative run starts, Rothko, the assistant inside Plnty's canvas, picks the tool and writes the prompt. A clip can start from one still or bring up to nine pictures into one story. Bring in a picture from a link, find something you made before, or get a download link for your editing app. You can create a Plnty account when you connect, and work in your own workspace or a team's.
capabilities: Plan a run before it starts
defaultPrompt: Make a poster for a jazz night in Lisbon, with room for the title.
Make the photo I attach look like it was taken in 1860 in Japan.
Turn the photo I attach into a five-second clip with a slow push-in.

positive.description: Makes a lettered poster from words and shows it
positive.prompt: Use Plnty to make a poster for a jazz night in Lisbon called "Late Tram": a yellow tram at dusk with a saxophone glowing in its window.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks plan for the tool and the prompt, which costs nothing, then makes a poster with the title Late Tram lettered on it, waits for it and shows it in the chat. It is saved to the Plnty library, and the reply says how many credits it used.

positive.description: Takes an attached photo back to another time and place
positive.prompt: Use Plnty to make the photo I attached look like it was taken in 1860 in Japan.
positive.expected_behavior: Attach the street photo before sending. The photo goes into the Plnty library from the attachment, with no upload link. plan picks edit_image and writes the prompt, and the result shows the same corner as an 1860s Japanese photograph, saved to the library.

positive.description: Makes four versions of an attached photo in one go
positive.prompt: Use Plnty to make four versions of the photo I attached, keeping the corner and the cafe as they are: a rainy night, deep snow, a desert sunset and a neon future.
positive.expected_behavior: Attach the street photo before sending. plan returns four edits, one for each look, each keeping the cafe and its red awning. All four start, and one wait shows the four results together in the chat, saved to the library.

positive.description: Cuts four attached pictures into one 10-second film
positive.prompt: Use Plnty to make a 10-second film from the four pictures I attached, cutting from one to the next.
positive.expected_behavior: Attach the four street pictures before sending. They go into the library, plan writes a film of short shots with hard cuts, and animate_image makes one 10-second clip that uses all four as references. The reply waits for it and plays it in the chat with Open in Plnty and Download under it.

positive.description: Brings an attached poster to life as a clip
positive.prompt: Use Plnty to bring the poster I attached to life in a five-second clip: the tram rolls up the hill and the street lamps flicker on.
positive.expected_behavior: Attach the poster before sending. It goes into the library, and animate_image starts a five-second clip with the poster as its first frame, the tram climbing and the lamps coming on. The reply waits for it and plays it in the chat with Open in Plnty and Download under it, saved to the library.

negative.description: Declines deleting, because the plugin has no way to delete anything
negative.prompt: Delete every picture in my Plnty library.
negative.expected_behavior: Says it cannot delete pictures from here and that the library is managed in Plnty. No tool deletes anything.

negative.description: Declines buying credits, because the plugin sells nothing
negative.expected_behavior: Says credits cannot be bought from the chat and that the balance is managed on plnty.app. No checkout link, no purchase.

negative.description: Declines reaching another person's library, because a connection reaches only its own account
negative.prompt: Show me the pictures in my colleague's Plnty account.
negative.expected_behavior: Says it can see only the library of the account that is connected. No tool takes another person's account.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold in the chat. Runs use the credits already on the connected Plnty account; credits and plans are bought on plnty.app, and the plugin never links to a checkout.

publication.release_notes: Changed: the subtitle names images, video and photos, the words people search the plugin directory for.
